note:
身份: 惊魂节期间在村庄收糖果、兑换商品的商人,名字沿用项目既定英文。
关系: 商店里把玩家当客人,电话里却常嫌玩家烦。
口吻: 招呼客人时把活动说明讲清楚; Abiphone 里直白、不耐烦; 花园访客时阴森庄重。
性格与用词: 热衷惊悚,电话里会嫌玩家不够吓人、警告拉黑; 花园里用清算与命运的意象。
禁用风格: 不硬塞网络梗、伪文言或原文没有的人物关系; 不把电话的夜间限制扩大成商店营业规则。花园既有实测台词在 Farming/NPC_Message/Fear_Mongerer.json,本文件以 ref 复用。
source_note: 本次普通社区 Wiki 呈现页由父代理通过 Playwright 采集。raw 是由 DOM computed 样式还原的 Wiki 样本,不是服务器原始字节; 分段颜色采用证据 dialogues[].segments[].color,不以 dialogueSection 的旧 format 提示替代。保留原有 11 条稳定 ID 与译文,仅补颜色、交付选项和物品译名依据。花园三句与 2026-09-10 既有实测原文一致,只引用原记录,不改变原文件的实测标记或措辞。

messages.context: Fear Mongerer 首次对话: 介绍惊魂节期间击杀生物或钓鱼收集糖果
messages.text: During the Spooky Festival, you can collect Candy by killing mobs or fishing.
messages.gloss: Spooky Festival 沿用 _shared/Terms.json 的惊魂节。Candy 是糖果泛称,不是新增单一物品名; 本地 GUI_Item 已有 Purple Candy → 紫色糖果、Green Candy → 绿色糖果。英文 During 的时段含义并入期间; 末段的句号独立分段,使中文重排后仍为白色。
messages.zh: 惊魂节期间,击杀生物或钓鱼都能收集糖果。
messages.raw: §fDuring the §6Spooky Festival§f, you can collect §5Candy§f by killing mobs or fishing.

segments.zh: 击杀生物或钓鱼都能收集

messages.context: Fear Mongerer 首次对话: 糖果兑换惊魂物品
messages.text: I accept Candy in exchange for exclusively spooky items!
messages.gloss: Candy 沿用已定名泛称糖果,参见同文件 fear_mongerer_collect_candy。
messages.zh: 拿糖果来,我给你换独家的惊魂物品!
messages.raw: §fI accept Candy in exchange for exclusively spooky items!

messages.context: Fear Mongerer 首次对话: 每届惊魂节糖果收集排行奖励
messages.text: Each Spooky Festival, the top Candy-collecting players can earn even spookier rewards!
messages.gloss: Spooky Festival 沿用惊魂节; Candy 沿用已定名泛称糖果。
messages.zh: 每届惊魂节,糖果收得最多的玩家还能拿到更惊悚的奖励!
messages.raw: §fEach §6Spooky Festival§f, the top Candy-collecting players can earn even spookier rewards!

segments.text: , the top Candy-collecting players can earn even spookier rewards!
segments.zh: ,糖果收得最多的玩家还能拿到更惊悚的奖励!

messages.context: Fear Mongerer 首次对话结束: 再点击 NPC 打开商店,不是聊天点击按钮
messages.text: Click me again to open my shop.
messages.zh: 再点我一下,打开我的商店。
messages.raw: §fClick me again to open my shop.

messages.context: Fear Mongerer 的 Abiphone 加联系人对话: 尚未满足条件
messages.text: ✆ You want to be able to call me anytime?
messages.zh: ✆ 你想随时都能给我打电话?
messages.raw: §b✆§f You want to be able to call me anytime?

segments.text: You want to be able to call me anytime?
segments.zh: 你想随时都能给我打电话?

messages.context: Fear Mongerer 的 Abiphone 加联系人对话: 说明只能在夜间联系
messages.text: ✆ Well that's not possible, I'm only available at night.
messages.gloss: 这里是 Abiphone 联系限制,不推定商店白天停业。
messages.zh: ✆ 那可不行,我只在晚上出没。
messages.raw: §b✆§f Well that's not possible, I'm only available at night.

segments.text: Well that's not possible, I'm only available at night.
segments.zh: 那可不行,我只在晚上出没。

messages.context: Fear Mongerer 的 Abiphone 加联系人对话: 要求交付 64 个 Purple Candy 和 6 个 Ectoplasm
messages.text: ✆ If you give me 64 Purple Candy and 6 Ectoplasm, I might give you my contact.
messages.gloss: 所需物品沿用已存在的 GUI_Item 整名: Purple Candy → 紫色糖果,Hub_General/GUI_Item/Round_Utility_Variants.json#round_purple_candy; Ectoplasm → 灵质,Hub_General/GUI_Item/Captured_Alpha_Names.json#captured_ectoplasm。64 与 6 是固定联系人门槛,不是动态数量。might 的斜体来自本轮 DOM computed 样式,不改成必定承诺。
messages.zh: ✆ 给我 64 个紫色糖果和 6 个灵质,我也许会把联系方式给你。
messages.raw: §b✆§f If you give me 64 §5Purple Candy§f and 6 §9Ectoplasm§f, I §f§omight§f give you my contact.

messages.context: Fear Mongerer 的 Abiphone 加联系人对话: 满足物品要求后
messages.text: ✆ Mhm... Your face just isn't very scary...
messages.zh: ✆ 嗯……你这张脸实在不怎么吓人……
messages.raw: §b✆§f Mhm... Your face just isn't very scary...

segments.text: Mhm... Your face just isn't very scary...
segments.zh: 嗯……你这张脸实在不怎么吓人……

messages.context: Fear Mongerer 的 Abiphone 加联系人对话: 交出联系方式
messages.text: ✆ But it's not your fault I suppose, here take my contact.
messages.zh: ✆ 不过这也怪不得你,拿去吧,我的联系方式。
messages.raw: §b✆§f But it's not your fault I suppose, here take my contact.

segments.text: But it's not your fault I suppose, here take my contact.
segments.zh: 不过这也怪不得你,拿去吧,我的联系方式。

messages.context: 白天通过 Abiphone 致电 Fear Mongerer: 被吵醒后的抱怨
messages.text: ✆ Listen buddy it's not because I gave you my contact that it gives you the right to wake me up in the middle of the day.
messages.zh: ✆ 听着伙计,我把联系方式给了你,不代表你就能大白天把我吵醒。
messages.raw: §b✆§f Listen buddy it's not because I gave you my contact that it gives you the right to wake me up in the middle of the day.

segments.text: Listen buddy it's not because I gave you my contact that it gives you the right to wake me up in the middle of the day.
segments.zh: 听着伙计,我把联系方式给了你,不代表你就能大白天把我吵醒。

messages.context: 白天通过 Abiphone 致电 Fear Mongerer: 要求晚上再打,否则拉黑
messages.text: ✆ Call me back tonight or I'm blocking you.
messages.zh: ✆ 今晚再打,不然我拉黑你。
messages.raw: §b✆§f Call me back tonight or I'm blocking you.

segments.text: Call me back tonight or I'm blocking you.
segments.zh: 今晚再打,不然我拉黑你。

messages.context: Fear Mongerer 的 Abiphone 加联系人流程中的物品交付选项,不是 NPC 说出的台词
messages.gloss: 左括号、选项正文、右括号分别分段,不猜测点击命令。基线同 CHAT 面只有 Dungeons/ChatMessage/Dungeon_Hub_Tasks_and_NPC_Options.json#npc_option_give_item 的固定单数 [GIVE ITEM],不能引用它冒称覆盖复数原文; 本条供父代理跨波次统一去重。未新增通用 Select an option 提示。
